remarks: Discover refined, better-than-new construction at 9 White Barns Lane, ideally located in the desirable White Barns community within Norwalk's sought-after Cranbury neighborhood. Built in 2023, this exceptional 4,900+/- Sq. Ft. residence offers 4/5 bedrooms and 4 full/1 half baths of thoughtfully designed living space with incredible flexibility for today's lifestyle. Crafted with quality and attention to detail, the home features custom millwork, high-end finishes, and a seamless open-concept layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The main level offers expansive living and dining spaces centered around a modern kitchen, all filled with natural light. Upstairs, the private primary suite and well-proportioned secondary bedrooms provide comfort and functionality. The finished lower level offers ideal space for recreation, fitness, a bedroom, or media room, while the third floor flex space creates an additional opportunity for an office, playroom, or alternative gym location. Outdoor living is equally inviting, with a large bluestone patio overlooking the natural surroundings. A rare opportunity to own a nearly new home in a highly desirable White Barns neighborhood just minutes to shopping, dining, and commuting options in Norwalk, Westport, and Wilton.
